announcer.text: METEOR IMPACT on MAGRATHEA. A rogue meteor punched through the surface. The crust has reset, new ore is exposed, and mining is open again.

items: Meteor impact. A rogue rock punched straight through the old crust.
The crater is open, and fresh ore veins are exposed.
Get down there and salvage what the rock is hiding.

announcer.text: NUCLEAR WAR on MAGRATHEA. Atomic fire swept the planet from horizon to horizon. The crust has reset, new ore is exposed, and mining is open again.

items: Nuclear war. Atomic fire swept the planet from horizon to horizon.
The blast waves split the crust and exposed new materials.
Everything old is ash; the survivors are already picking through the rubble.

announcer.text: SOLAR FLARE on MAGRATHEA. The local star lashed out and cooked the daylight side. The crust has reset, new ore is exposed, and mining is open again.

items: Solar flare. The local star lashed out and cooked the daylight side.
The magnetic storm peeled back rock and scattered rare elements.
The surface is hot, but the ore is close.

announcer.text: ALIEN INVASION on MAGRATHEA. An alien fleet razed the planet from orbit. The crust has reset, new ore is exposed, and mining is open again.

items: Alien invasion. A fleet razed the planet from orbit.
Their beams demolished the old surface and scattered new materials.
Whatever they were looking for, they left plenty behind for us.
